text:
sam_ae: FYI — Acme Global is ready to move to a POC contract but we hit 3 procurement/legal blockers. Need help routing order form + MSA/DPA redlines. They need split billing across US and UK entities, SOC2 language in the DPA, and a nonstandard signature flow where AP signs the PO but legal needs countersign.

mike_legal: Copy. Do we have their signed MSA template or are they requesting changes to ours?

sam_ae: They want us to use our MSA but with two edits: (1) add explicit EU data residency + subprocessors clause, (2) change indemnity cap to 1.5x fees for the first year. They've also flagged SLA uptime points (latency SLOs) in the order form.

anita_finance: For split billing — which legal entities and billing addresses? Also need payment terms: they asked for net60 and a PO number flow.

sam_ae: Billing entities: Acme Global, Inc. (US) and Acme Global Ltd (UK). PO will be issued by the UK entity for the UK spend. They want consolidated invoice to the US AP but payment routed per PO.

evan_se: On the POC side — are they expecting Dedicated or Hosted? That affects pricing and SLA language. POC workload is ~4k requests/day, 8k tokens avg.

sam_ae: They asked for Dedicated for data isolation, but are open to Hosted if we can guarantee no cross-tenant caching and a DPA addendum.

sara_security: I need the security questionnaire answers before I approve any DPA tweaks. Also they want customer-managed KMS key mention in the DPA. Is that required or nice-to-have?

sam_ae: They prefer customer-managed KMS for the UK data. It might be a gating item for the Dedicated option.

mike_legal: Uploading a delta redline to the contract review queue now. Contract Bot: can you create a review ticket and tag security + finance?

contract-bot: Ticket created: CR-2026-4532. Reviewers: mike_legal, sara_security, anita_finance. Link: https://contracts.internal/review/CR-2026-4532 :white_check_mark:

anita_finance: We can accept net60 for the POC if billing follows the UK PO for UK spend. Quick question: need pricing split. Sam, what's the POC committed spend?

sam_ae: POC estimate: $18,500 total over 60 days. Rough split: US $8,000 / UK $10,500. Can we put line items on the order form per-entity?

mike_legal: Yes, we can do per-entity line items. I'll add an "Order Form: Billing Entities" table in the OF redline. Also will propose a signature block for multiple signatories with delegated countersign via email. Any objections?

evan_se: If we do Dedicated for UK traffic + Hosted for US, we should list failover behavior in the OF (i.e., fallback to hosted variant if Dedicated capacity insufficient). That ties into SLA and pricing for failover.

sara_security: From security POV we need: SOC2 report access, encryption at rest with CMK for UK data, subprocessors list, and right to audit language. I can draft the DPA patch.

mike_legal: Draft DPA patch sounds good. For indemnity cap — 1.5x fees is unusual but negotiable for a limited POC term. I'll propose a timeboxed cap (1.5x for first 90 days, revert to standard afterwards).

anita_finance: Also flagging: accounting needs the vendor W-9 / VAT registration. Sam — can you confirm VAT number for Acme UK and if they need reverse charge?

sam_ae: I'll ask Acme AP this morning and post the VAT number here.

contract-bot: Attached: redline packet (msas/OF/DPA) uploaded by mike_legal at 2026-03-22T10:04Z.

mike_legal: Ping me once VAT/PO flow confirmed. I'll finalize signature lanes: (1) UK PO + UK billing (2) US consolidated invoice for reporting. We'll add a clause: "Invoices issued per PO must match billing entity and currency."

sam_ae: Quick note for SEs: customer will run load tests mid-POC week 3. Evan, can we reserve capacity for that window? :eyes:

evan_se: Yes — I'll reserve a small Dedicated pool for week 3 and add a playbook for cache warmup. Code snippet for reservation command I'll run on infra:

```
# reserve dedicated pool
reserve_pool --env=uk-dedicated --gpu=1 --duration=7d --tag=acme-poc-week3
```

sara_security: I'll prepare the DPA draft and mark any items that require escalation to InfoSec leadership. If they insist on HSM-backed keys, that's a separate procurement conversation.

mike_legal: OK team — plan: (1) Sam to confirm VAT/PO routing and customer signature contacts; (2) Anita to prepare PO/invoice template for dual-entity billing; (3) Evan to reserve capacity and provide failover language; (4) Sara to draft DPA redline with CMK language; (5) I'll circulate final order form + multi-signature block for countersign. Target: get countersigned POC order in 7 business days. :thumbsup:

sam_ae: Thanks — I'll update Acme and post their VAT and PO contact here in <24h.

anita_finance: Adding: please cc finance on the PO email thread so we can validate VAT treatment.

contract-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 48 hours for CR-2026-4532.

sam_ae: ACK.
